correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed 28 vertices from noncollinear Fano triples, 42 edges, 24 length-seven cycles, 108 disjoint pairs and cubical chain ranks (378,1092,777). All torus two-chains have zero signed boundary. A 77-column torus minor has determinant -1, proving integral primitivity in C_2; rank(d_2)=700 follows from rank mod 101 >=700 and 77 independent kernel cycles. Independent graph-isomorphism enumeration found all 336 automorphisms and transitive orbits of sizes 84 (2 cross edges) and 24 (0 cross edges). The two-cross-edge sublattice has rank 76 modulo three and full rational rank 77; two maximal integral coordinate minors -273 and 5427 have gcd 3, so its index is exactly three. Transitivity, invariant sublattice and surjectivity of the combined tori imply any zero-cross-edge torus completes. The cubical model deformation retracts for n=2 because the graph meets Abrams sufficient-subdivision conditions. These checks are exact finite calculations for the specified graph, not extrapolation.
